subject: Moscow repels dozens of Ukrainian drones in daytime attack
posts: Moscow claims a successful defense against a massive drone swarm, but the reality is a city under persistent, disruptive siege. Evidence: Defensive success, Persistent disruption, War escalation. #Ukraine #Russia
